verdicts.evidence: Independent inspection of the uncommitted diff against 9ccb117f plus runtime checks in this worktree. (1) src/shared/quota-presentation.ts getQuotaWindowDuration resolves a positive safe-integer limit_window_seconds first, falls back to finite positive window_minutes*60 only when the product is a positive safe integer, and returns null otherwise — verified by code read and by my own probes in tests/evaluator/bl-codex-quota-window-f001-f002.test.ts (19/19 pass), covering precedence over conflicting legacy minutes, non-integer seconds (18000.5->null), legacy float products (0.1min->{second,6}; 0.07min->null; 1/3min->{second,20} exactly as IEEE-754 dictates), no-rounding (604799->{second,604799}), MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, boolean minutes, and non-object rawJson (function/Date/bigint->null). (2) Largest-exact-unit formatting week>day>hour>minute>second with %-based exactness, no inference from position/plan/timestamps/countdown: generator regressions prove weekly-only primary (604800s) renders 'weekly'/'一周' with no fabricated secondary row, normal and swapped dual windows (18000s<->604800s) follow their own durations, all four positions honor legacy minutes, and reset_after_seconds-only payloads render the localized unknown label. (3) app/_components/subscription-card.tsx RateLimitRow computes the label from rawJson via t('subscription.codex.rateRemaining'|'codeReviewRemaining',{window}) with Intl.NumberFormat long units and a windowWeekly special case; code-review rows use the identical rule. DOM structure, bar classes, percentages, reset/capture rows, freshness (stale row still shows Awaiting refresh/待刷新 with no percentage) and account ordering all preserved — asserted in my render probes (bar class 'h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full', '60%', 'Resets at:/重置于：', window order) and the untouched subscription-card.test.ts freshness/timezone cases. (4) D-i18n: messages/en.json and zh-CN.json replace ratePrimary/rateSecondary/codeReviewPrimary/codeReviewSecondary with rateRemaining/codeReviewRemaining{window}+windowWeekly+windowUnknown; my parity probe confirms key/{window}-placeholder alignment in both locales and removal of the old keys; retained flatten-based parity test passes.
